principle: All spoken segments derive their visual duration from the measured WAV duration plus explicit pre/post padding. Transition time is reserved inside padding where possible.

transition.note: scene_crossfade_sec is budgeted inside the following poem pre-roll and is not added again to total duration.

reveal.content_line: Reveal at event start, then wait poem pre-roll before speech.
reveal.explanation: Reveal at explanation event start; hide after its post-roll.
reveal.page_turn: Clear content zone, hold page_turn_pause_sec, then reveal new page slot 1.

constraints.rounding: Keep internal timestamps at millisecond precision; composer later snaps to video frames.
